## Outcome

What user or contributor problem does this solve?

## Scope

- Routes/components/data changed:
- Out of scope:

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm validate`
- [ ] `pnpm privacy:scan`
- [ ] `pnpm web:build`
- [ ] Keyboard and focus states checked
- [ ] Mobile and desktop checked where UI changed
- [ ] Console checked where UI changed

## Trust and review gates

- [ ] No personal or production data included
- [ ] External facts include provenance and freshness
- [ ] Permit/cost/safety/religious claims preserve required review boundaries
- [ ] Asset rights are documented
- [ ] RLS/security tests included if project/member data changed

## Evidence

Screenshots, test output, source links and remaining limitations.
